extension.summary: Browse and stream YouTube channels. No login, no API.
extension.description: Channels are configured in channels.conf (Kan Gaming, ScrapMan, Midwest Safety, Off the Hook, Daz Games included). Browse every video of a channel, search within a channel, or search all of YouTube. Videos stream in up to 720p via the bundled yt-dlp, or download with live progress to the addon's downloads folder. Download list with delete is in the main menu. No YouTube login or API key required.
